Name: Ben-ammi, Son of Lot
Summary: Ben-ammi was the son of Lot by his younger daughter, born in the cave after Sodom's destruction, and the ancestor of the Ammonites.
KeyStory: Lot's younger daughter bore Ben-ammi, whose name means 'son of my people,' and whose descendants became the nation of Ammon.
RelatedPeople: Lot; Lot's Wife; Moab, Son of Lot
LifeLesson: God's story keeps moving through families we know almost nothing about — and He knows them all.
